rich_signature.text:
//! Three bands: OKLCH hue sweep, OKLab blending, and lightness/chroma field.
//! The same perceptual_color ingot is used by the Mandelbrot renderer.
use core::marker::Copy
use std::webgpu::{
    FragmentSurface,
    GpuProgram,
    ResponsiveBacking,
    StandardSurfaceRecovery,
    SurfaceQuality,
    SurfaceRecovery,
    SurfaceTransition,
    WebGpuBackend,
}
use std::web::

::{
    ApplyParamBindings,
    Extent,
    Param,
    ParamBindingsProvider,
    Surface,
    SurfaceEvent,
    SurfaceState,
}
use fmath::from_i32
use perceptual_color::{Oklch, oklch, blend, display_rgba}

pub struct ColorParams {
    pub hue: Param,
    pub chroma: Param,
    pub lightness: Param,
    pub res: Param,
}

pub struct ColorState {
    pub hue: f32,
    pub chroma: f32,
    pub lightness: f32,
    pub res: f32,
}

impl Copy for
derive ApplyParamBindings for ColorState using ParamBindingsProvider<ColorParams>
